Subject: Need help with a land dispute case

Hello, my name is Thomas Mehra. I am a 71-year-old hardware dealer living in Kolhapur. I have a land dispute with Ananya Goyal over land worth Rs. 3,33,00,000, and construction has started on the disputed plot. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 77121 50850 or email thomas.mehra@example.com.
